items.prompt: Explain why a dilation produces a figure similar to the original.
items.answer: A dilation multiplies every length by the same factor $k$ and preserves angles, so corresponding sides stay in the same ratio and angles stay equal, which is the definition of similar figures.

steps: Equal angles and proportional sides mean similar.
